rationale: Field and laboratory role on construction materials testing and geotechnical investigations: soil logging, sampling, field density tests, lab tests to Australian Standards, field notes, site plans and QA records, which overlaps Marc's AS 1289 and AS 1726 coursework and his 2019 to 2020 site inspections, quality checks and site reports.
